Maria K.: Nightly eval spike for q6f-quantized v1 — large drop in avg entropy on 'summaries-core' after fused_sampler_v2 roll. Samples show repeated fragments and early stop. Attaching one generated example.
nightly-eval-bot: nightly-evals/1933337777 -> https://ci.redwood/ev/4527 — delta: entropy -1.8, regen rate +12% :rotating_light:
Sam P.: can you paste the raw sample and the eval config?
Maria K.: ```
# eval call
run_eval --model q6f-v1 --sampler fused_sampler_v2 --prompts summaries-core
```
Maria K.: ```
Generated: "The patient was diagnosed with the condition. The patient was diagnosed with the condition. The patient was diagnosed..."
```
Alex R.: I merged a change yesterday that reorders topk->topp path for fused_sampler_v2 (commit 0ab3f7). @Sam P. @Jordan L. might explain why this affects q6f quantization.
Jordan L.: possible tie-breaker bias introduced by tie-breaker RNG seed when scores close; q6f quantized logits can cluster. Also double-check kv cache reuse between requests.
Sam P.: repro locally with same weights and flags -> reproduces. Logs:
```
INFO: sampling: repeated token detected: 'The'
DEBUG: topk scores: [0.23,0.229,0.229]
```
Sam P.: disabling fused_sampler_v2 via runtime flag flips back to v1 and fixes outputs. Throughput drop ~5%.
Maria K.: good repro. q6f only affected, fp16/ffn19 models OK. Looks like quantization exacerbates tie-break cases.
Alex R.: I'll bisect commit series starting from 0ab3f7. If quick fix messy, we can gate fused_sampler_v2 for quantized models in runtime.
Sam P.: created issue #4527: https://phab.redwood/4527 — includes logs, sample, and repro steps :eyes:
deploy-bot: rolled back runtime flag on staging for fused_sampler_v2 for q6f models
Maria K.: thanks. Can we add a small test in nightly-evals to catch repeats >3 tokens for summaries-core? :thinking:
Jordan L.: +1. I'll add a regression assert and a small prompt set.
Maria K.: linking to issue in thread.
